text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shiina Frejus had to give up on the Kikuka 
Sho due to an injury. Katsuragi Ace called 
out to her with concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, Shiina Frejus felt a sense of relief. 
No longer would she be compared to Mr. 
C.B. She wouldn't have to fight against a 
"different world."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace, who thought Shiina Frejus 
was also an existence from the "other 
world," was surprised to learn that 
everyone has their own "other world."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Katsuragi Ace believed. That 
someone who had fought so desperately up 
to this point would surely be able to run 
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I will keep showing everyone 
what it means to push forward without 
fear. Did her shouting voice reach them? 
The final leg of the Classic Triple Crown, 
the Kikuka Sho, was fast approaching...!"
